    Graded modules and push-downs of piece representations #

    If the piece representation grRep S of a graded k(P)-module M is isomorphic to a representation Y of a convex piece S, then M is isomorphic to the push-down pdMod S Y (exists_bijective_pdMod).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_bijective_pdMod {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} (k : Type u) [Field k] {ℓ : (y : P) → vtx x₀ ⟶ vtx y} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) M] {μ : Graded.GrMod (rayGrAlg ℓ k) M} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (hS : ∀ (a : Cover x₀), W ℓ k μ a ≠ ⊥ → a ∈ S) (hconv : Cover.Convex ↑S) (Y : Rep k (pieceQuiver S)) (hY : RespectsCover Y) [∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), FiniteDimensional k ↑(Y.obj i)] (φ : grRep ℓ k μ S ≅ Y) :
    ∃ (f : M →ₗ[RayQuiver.Linearization P k] (pdMod hconv Y hY).carrier), Function.Bijective ⇑f

    A graded module is the push-down of any representation isomorphic to its piece representation.
